Why cats love boxes

Cats are famously ephemeral in their interests, but boxes are a lasting obsession.

Researchers in the Netherlands found that shelter cats given a hiding box adapted to their new surroundings much faster than cats without one.

Enclosed spaces make cats feel safe from predators, which lowers their stress levels when everything else around them is unfamiliar.

Boxes also keep cats warm, because cats are most comfortable at temperatures well above what most humans prefer indoors.

Scientists think the box habit comes from wild ancestors that hid in small dens to ambush prey and to rest safely between hunts.
